meta.name: case-study-writing
meta.description: B2B case study writing with STAR framework, data visualization, and research. Covers structure, customer quotes, metrics presentation, and distribution formats. Use for: customer success stories, portfolio pieces, sales enablement, marketing content. Triggers: case study, customer story, success story, b2b case study, client testimonial, customer case study, portfolio case study, use case, customer win, results story

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用STAR框架撰写B2B客户成功案例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要撰写客户成功故事来提升销售转化
copy.tagline_en: Write B2B customer success stories with the STAR framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write customer success stories to boost sales conversion

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能按 STAR 框架（情境-任务-行动-结果）撰写 B2B 案例研究，包括结构模板、客户引用、数据可视化建议和分发格式。
howto.when: 当用户提到“案例研究”、“客户故事”、“成功案例”等关键词，或要求撰写 B2B 客户成功故事时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 SaaS 客户案例，用 STAR 框架。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含情境、任务、行动、结果的结构化案例。

say.text: 给这个案例加一个数据对比图。
say.note: Claude 会生成生成前后对比图的代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write B2B case studies using the STAR framework (Situation-Task-Action-Result), including structure templates, customer quotes, data visualization suggestions, and distribution formats.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "case study", "customer story", "success story", or asks to write a B2B customer success story.

say_en.text: Write a SaaS customer case study using the STAR framework.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a structured case with Situation, Task, Action, Result.

say_en.text: Add a before/after comparison chart to this case.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code to create a comparison chart.
